products.name: Fat Tiger Blind Box — Dragon Soaring & Tiger Leaping Series
products.description: Blind box figure Alexander si Fat Tiger seri "Long Teng Hu Yue" (Dragon Soaring & Tiger Leaping). Tiap box berisi 1 figure acak dari 8 desain: Soaring Dragon, Leaping Tiger, Subduing Dragon, Crouching Tiger, Dragon Pool, Tiger's Den, Sleeping Dragon dan Fledgling Phoenix, plus peluang mendapatkan hidden edition "Coiling Dragon & Crouching Saw Tiger".
products.nameEn: Fat Tiger Blind Box — Dragon Soaring & Tiger Leaping Series
products.descriptionEn: Blind box figures of Alexander the Fat Tiger from the "Long Teng Hu Yue" (Dragon Soaring & Tiger Leaping) series. Each box contains 1 random figure out of 8 designs: Soaring Dragon, Leaping Tiger, Subduing Dragon, Crouching Tiger, Dragon Pool, Tiger's Den, Sleeping Dragon and Fledgling Phoenix, plus a chance to get the hidden edition "Coiling Dragon & Crouching Saw Tiger".

products.name: Fat Tiger Blind Box — Tiger Food Party Plush Pendant
products.description: Gantungan boneka (plush pendant) Fat Tiger seri "Tiger Food Party — Let's Eat Together". Tiap blind box berisi 1 gantungan acak dari 6 desain, lucu dipasang di tas atau kunci.
products.nameEn: Fat Tiger Blind Box — Tiger Food Party Plush Pendant
products.descriptionEn: Fat Tiger plush pendants from the "Tiger Food Party — Let's Eat Together" series. Each blind box contains 1 random pendant out of 6 designs, adorable on your bag or keys.

products.name: Rolife Super Creator — Double Joy Bubble Tea
products.description: Kit rumah miniatur DIY dari Rolife seri Super Creator bertema kedai bubble tea "Double Joy". Rakit sendiri jadi pajangan meja yang detail dan menggemaskan.
products.nameEn: Rolife Super Creator — Double Joy Bubble Tea
products.descriptionEn: A DIY miniature house kit from Rolife's Super Creator series, themed as the "Double Joy" bubble tea shop. Build it yourself into a detailed and charming desk display.
